message:
chore: scope.js stops importing from the analysis visitors (#18787)

`phases/scope.js` imported `validate_identifier_name` from
`2-analyze/visitors/shared/utils.js`, which imports `get_rune` back from
`scope.js`. The check reads a `Binding` and `Scope.declare` is its main
caller, so it now lives in `scope.js`. No behaviour change.
